Verifies that {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder} encodes the name "Smyth" to the Match Rating Approach code "SMYTH".

"Smyth" has 5 characters, so encoding leaves it essentially unchanged: uppercasing yields "SMYTH", removing non-leading vowels keeps it as "SMYTH" (there are no vowels to drop), there are no double consonants to collapse, and since the name is not longer than 6 characters it is returned in full.
